title: A Tapestry of Grace
note: Front & back cover for Selin Magazine featuring SCALA wear.
text: Tedeski brothers, Anestis and Edouardo, stand entwined in red and petrol tapestries. A duet of color and poise. Their silhouettes, poised yet unspoken, draw elegance from the threads themselves. Every fold, every glance, an ode to quiet grandeur. Delicate figures breathe life into the fabric’s stillness, turning old weaves into whispers of timeless class.
